title: polypodium vulgare subsp. zuvandicum
intro: Polypodium vulgare subsp. zuvandicum, commonly known as Zuvandi maidenhair fern, is a subspecies of the Polypodium vulgare fern, native to the Caucasus region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Zuvandi maidenhair fern include wound healing, anti-arthritic, and anti-diabetic properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
